notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon Patch Notes (Version: 1.3.7290)
notes.notes:
Hello Sword-Smoochers!

We have a patch that addresses some of the smaller bugs from the Secret Weapons update including some localization errors that prevented non-English speakers from earning achievements.

Version: 1.3.7290:

 The final boss fight now has a new, fully-voiced conversation between your weapon and the antagonist, before the final phase.

 Jonah, Leah, and Rowan’s birthday gifts will now all show in the apartment.

 All shops should now always function in all languages, finally allowing non-English speakers to collect all outfits.

 Hammer’s final date will now make much more sense in German and Portuguese.    

 Various small fixes to dialogue and localization.

In cased you missed it, our last patch fixed the progression issues with Hammer. Please continue to report any bugs or issues on our Known Issues thread!

-Alexandra and the Kitfox Crew!

notes.title: We won another big award, and we have news about the big update coming!
notes.notes:
Hey sword smoochers,

It's Alexandra from Kitfox here with an update on how work has been coming along on the Boyfriend Dungeon DLC as well as some other exciting news. If you've signed up for our Boyfriend Dungeon newsletter, you have already received love letters from Axe, Hammer and the mysterious "H". I can't reveal who the mystery person is quite yet but I hear they are involved with developing new boss fight technology. Sounds like someone I don't want to mess with.  

But with all these mysteries afoot, it only makes sense to name the DLC update "Secret Weapons".

A Formal Event

You are cordially invited to attend a special formal event and all the bae blades will be dressed in their finest threads. This will be a story event that takes place during the DLC and wielders will have a chance to take their partner along! Here is what Seven and Sawyer are planning to wear:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/bb993da4bab36376854cd5980331ae0156289d44.png

Pretty dapper if I do say so myself! 

Hub Encounters

We are introducing a new DLC feature called "Hub Encounters" where you'll be able to interact with the bae blades while you're exploring the dunj. All of the weapons have been turned into adorable chibi forms. During these encounters you will see new scenes between weapons, most of whom have never interacted together before. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31259798/87807f5cebd8f40384ee248f8df2e2c3de3cfb09.jpg

For example, Rowan and Sunder compare hair products. Valeria paints Pocket's portrait. And many more! They're little scenes you'll be able to find in the city between dating and dungeoning, including our dear new Leah and Jonah.

Game Developer's Choice Award

Just last night, Boyfriend Dungeon was awarded the Game Developer's Choice Award for Social Impact. We are incredibly thankful to be honored among so many other amazing games. 

We also won a Spawnie Award for Diversity, a show hosted by the lovely folks at Spawn On Me! 

We are nominated for a few more awards so stay tuned for those shows:

GLAAD Media Awards (April 2nd)

Outstanding Video Game

Gayming Awards (April 25th)

Game of the Year

Gayming Magazine Readers' Award

Authentic Representation Award

Best LGBTQ Indie Game Award

Tiktok Live Q&A 

I'll be Live on the Kitfox Tiktok to hang out and chat with ya'll about all things Kitfox. Come with your questions about Boyfriend Dungeon, our other games or just to talk about a cool snack you've tried.  I'll be live March 24th (that's today!) at 3pm Eastern!

Looking forward to seeing ya'll!

Alexandra + Tanya and Kitfox Games

notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon Patch Notes (Version: 1.2.6301)
notes.notes:
Hello Sword-Smoochers!

A small patch for you today. We're fully focusing on the new weapons/update content for now, unless we find something truly horrible we MUST fix in the interim.  We still anticipate it will take us some months, so please be patient. In the meantime, seeing all of your discussions and fanarts and mods and such is very inspiring, so, thank you for those! 🧡

Version: 1.2.6301:


  Updated Kickstarter backer credits to include names registered up until September 27.
  There is now a special sfx sometimes when you kill the last enemy in a challenge
  Secret passage entrances should now play sound effects when destroyed
  Lasersaber and Estoc combat sfx should now play properly (even when upgraded and/or charging attacks)
  Rowan/Scythe will no longer sometimes show up in two places at once while receiving a gift
  Various small audio and text improvements
  Adjustment to the Flutterbug difficulty


We continue to work on getting Hammer and Axe ready for their trip to Verona Beach but please continue to report any bugs or issues on our Known Issues thread!

-Alexandra, Tanya and the Kitfox Crew!

notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon Patch Notes (Version 1.2.6266)
notes.notes:
Hey there Sword Smoochers!

We have a thread of known issues that might be helpful to anyone having trouble with the game.

Here are the patch notes to go along with today's update:

Version: 1.2.6266


  Achievements should now be less prone to error and actually fire correctly if all equipment and gifts received.

  The content warning translation has been updated to match the English improvements.

  If you receive enough experience to reach level 51, the dungeon should now still function correctly.

  If you get a Game Over during a date, reloading should now function correctly.

 If you previously received a Game Over during a date, that save file should also now function correctly.

  (Uncertain) Crafting text should get cut off/masked/hidden less often now.

  You can no longer get stuck in phase 3 of the final boss fight (or after the boss fight) by doing damage to people or enemies that were meant to be invulnerable.

  Using the Phoenix Cap during the final boss and then losing should now give you a new Phoenix Cap during your re-attempt.


We also wanted to let everyone know that we are officially on break starting tomorrow! It's been a busy last few weeks and after working on Boyfriend Dungeon for 4 years (wow!) the whole team is taking a much deserved rest. Expect communication to be a bit slower during this time. We hope to return refreshed and ready to start working on Hammer and Axe! Thank you to everyone who supported us on this journey to release and we hope you are enjoying the game so far!

-Alexandra, Tanya and the Kitfox team

notes.title: Update to Content Warning
notes.notes:
Version: 1.1.6249 is now available on Steam.

We're still working on many important fixes, but here's what we could feel confident about putting up today. If you want to track our known issues, here is the discussion thread to watch!


 The content warning has been updated with stronger language to reflect the game more accurately. (English only -- translations will follow)
 Changed Halo to give more healing from beverages, rather than resurrect once.
 Removed unnecessary reference to still-birth.
 If your Windows is in Korean, it will no longer launch the game into an unfinished Korean translation.
 If Vegan, Estoc will cook a scramble for you instead of eggs. (voice line still says eggs for now)
 (Uncertain) The Cap recipe may now function correctly. 


We'll continue updating the game as quickly as we can find and fix the issues. Thank you for your patience and support.

notes.title: Boyfriend Dungeon will update with 'more accurate' content warning about stalking
notes.notes:
Boyfriend Dungeon is about dating and dungeon crawling with swords... that are also people. It had a surprise release on the 11th of August, and despite its goofy premise on the surface, its story explores some sensitive themes, as Rachel noted in her preview: "Dating for many women and queer folk in general is, unfortunately, a huge risk, and meeting in public, having a friend on hand, and checking out the place are just some of the many safety tips used when meeting dates the first time. For a game about smooching sharp weapons, it's great to see Boyfriend Dungeon acknowledge that."..
                Read more.
